questions.stem: The upstream speed of a boat is 18 km/hr which is 500% more than the speed of stream. Find how much distance boat will cover in 3 hours while travelling in downstream.
questions.explanation: Let the speed of stream be 𝑥 km/hr Then, Speed of upstream = 𝑥× 100 = 18 ⇒ 𝑥 = 3km/hr Speed of boat in still water = 18 + 3 = 21 km/hr Distance covered in 3 hours in downstream = (21 + 3) × 3 = 72 km

questions.stem: If A^{2}– B^{2} = 252 and A + B = 42 then find the value of ‘B’?
questions.explanation: (A + B)(A – B) = 252 ⇒ 42 × (A– B) = 252 [A + B = 42 given] ⇒ (A– B) = 6 …(i) And A + B = 42 …(ii) Solve (i) and (ii), we get ⇒ B = 18

questions.stem: A alone can do a work in 40 days. The ratio of time taken by A and B to do the same work is 5 : 3. Then, find in how many days both will complete the work together ?
questions.explanation: Let the time taken by A and B be 5𝑥 days and 3𝑥 days respectively. ⇒ 5𝑥 = 40 days ⇒ 𝑥 = 8 days B’s time = 3 × 8 = 24 days Time taken by both together to complete the work = 40×24 40+24 [𝑢𝑠𝑒 𝑎×𝑏 𝑎+𝑏 for two persons] =15 days.

questions.stem: A train having speed of 72 km/hr crosses a pole in 18 sec and a platform in 33 sec. Find the length of platform?
questions.explanation: Speed of train = 72 km/hr = 72 × 18 = 20 m/s Length of train = 18 × 20 = 360 m Length of (train + platform) = 20 × 33 = 660 m ∴ length of platform = 660 m – 360 m = 300 m

questions.stem: The circumference of a circle is 66 cm. Find the approximate area of square if the radius of circle is two times of the side of a square.

questions.stem: The total age of A, B and C four years hence will be 98 years. Find the age of C four years hence if the present age of A and B is 32 years and 23 years respectively.
